c74object.name: lp.lili
c74object.description: lp.lili generates random integers with the linear congruence method, whose parameters you can play with. The defaults give the same numbers as Max.

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet: Set the seed and output. In the 2nd inlet: multiplier. In the 3rd inlet: adder. In the 4th inlet: modulo.

method.name: seed
method.digest: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically)
method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).
